title: Excursion form
purpose: Record a new temperature excursion, or change the details of one that is still open.
summary: Record a new temperature excursion, or change the details of one that is still open.

tasks.title: Record an excursion
steps: Choose the [[Equipment]] and enter [[Started]]. Leave [[Ended]] blank while it is ongoing.
Choose [[Detected by]] and [[Cause category]], then select [[Create excursion]].

tasks.title: Complete the details
steps: Add [[Ended]], [[Cause]], [[Action taken]] and [[Impact assessment]], then select [[Save changes]].

good_to_know: The equipment's storage unit and current limits are saved with the excursion.
End, cause, action taken and impact assessment are needed before submitting.
Do not enter donor, patient or participant names in any field.

sections.title: Who can use it and when
paragraphs: Technicians, managers and administrators. Viewers are refused. A new excursion is for a tank, freezer or other equipment that is not retired; temperature monitors are not offered. Editing is possible only while the excursion is Open: when it is awaiting review or closed the form opens as Not available, and a manager returns it for more work or reopens it first. When the action is not possible right now, the form opens with a Not available notice that gives the reason, its fields are disabled and there is no submit button; Cancel returns to the record. The checks are repeated on the server when you save, so a form that opens is not a guarantee.

Times are repository local time, to the second, and cannot be in the future. If someone else changed the record after you opened this form, the save is refused with a message that it changed since you opened it. Nothing is saved; reload, check the current values and enter the change again.

items.label: Equipment
items.description: New only, required. The tank or freezer. Its storage unit and the limits set on it when you save are stored with the excursion and do not change later. When it has no storage unit, no specimens can be listed.

items.label: Started
items.description: Required. When the temperature went outside the limits. Defaults to now.

items.label: Ended
items.description: Optional while it is ongoing. Not before the start. It is required before submitting for review.

items.label: Extreme reached, Extreme reached at
items.description: Optional. The extreme temperature in °C (up to two decimals) and when it was reached, which must fall within the excursion.

items.label: Detected by
items.description: Required: Alarm, Temperature reading, Inspection or level check, or Other.

items.label: Cause category
items.description: Required: Power failure, LN2 supply or fill, Equipment fault, Door or lid left open, Sensor or probe fault, Handling or access, Not yet known (the default) or Other.

items.label: Cause
items.description: Up to 4,000 characters; required before submitting for review.

items.label: Action taken
items.description: Up to 4,000 characters; required before submitting for review.

items.label: Impact assessment
items.description: Up to 4,000 characters; required before submitting. The effect on the specimens stored in the unit. Do not enter donor, patient or participant names or other text that could identify a person.

items.label: Note, Attachment
items.description: New only, optional. The first timeline note and a file (PDF, PNG, JPEG, TXT or CSV, up to 10 MiB, checked by content), downloaded as a file. If the repository has set a limit on the total size of attached files and it would be exceeded, the file is refused and nothing is recorded.

sections.title: Saving
paragraphs: Create excursion opens it as Open and shows its record. Save changes keeps the new values, bumps its revision and adds a Details updated entry to the timeline showing each value before and after; saving with no change is refused. Editing never needs a reason because the timeline keeps every earlier value.
